```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source(file = "./utils/exp2-utils.R") # loads all necessary packages
```

```{r data load}
dataPath <- "data/exp2/"
mg_pilot_df <- read_csv(paste(dataPath, "pilot-mg.csv", sep = ""), show_col_types = FALSE)
us_pilot_df <- read_csv(paste(dataPath, "pilot-us.csv", sep = ""), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r generate demographic data}
mg_pilot_dem <- getDemographics(mg_pilot_df)
us_pilot_dem <- getDemographics(us_pilot_df)
```

```{r filter out partial data}
# Keep only data w/ percentComplete 100% i.e. only ppt who finished the study
manual_keep_ids <- c("09b12105-8844-4979-b829-450cea06e9ee")
mg_pilot_df_finished <- mg_pilot_df %>%
  mutate(
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "undefined"),
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "null"),
    percentComplete = as.numeric(percentComplete)) %>%
  group_by(participantId) %>%
  filter(
    (any(!is.na(percentComplete)) &&
      max(percentComplete, na.rm = TRUE) == 100
    ) || any(participantId %in% manual_keep_ids)) %>% ungroup()

us_pilot_df_finished <- us_pilot_df %>%
  mutate(
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "undefined"),
    percentComplete = na_if(percentComplete, "null"),
    percentComplete = as.numeric(percentComplete)) %>%
  group_by(participantId) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(percentComplete)) &&
    max(percentComplete, na.rm = TRUE) == 100) %>% ungroup()
```


```{r}
# ID, Concept A, Concept B, Answer, Response Time, Category(MG_US_level), Color_left, Color_right, left_height, right_height
mg_ppt_response_df <- mg_pilot_df_finished %>%
  filter(
    responseId == "choice",
    str_detect(trialId, "^p[^_]*_s[^_]*_t[^_]*$")) %>%
  select(participantId, trialId, answer)

mg_clean_data <- getCleanData(mg_ppt_response_df) %>% 
  rename(conA_fr = conA, conB_fr = conB)
# Translate concept vector: French -> English
fr_to_en <- setNames(conceptListEn, conceptListFr)
mg_clean_data <- mg_clean_data %>%
  mutate(conA = fr_to_en[conA_fr], conB = fr_to_en[conB_fr], 
         .after = 'conA_fr') # %>% select(-c(conA_fr, conB_fr))

us_ppt_response_df <- us_pilot_df_finished %>%
  filter(
    responseId == "choice",
    str_detect(trialId, "^p[^_]*_s[^_]*_t[^_]*$")) %>%
  select(participantId, trialId, answer)

us_clean_data <- getCleanData(us_ppt_response_df)
```

```{r save data}
write.csv(mg_clean_data, "data/exp2/pilot-mg-clean2.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

write.csv(us_clean_data, "data/exp2/pilot-us-clean.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
```
